We are building the runtime systems that turn probabilistic token generation into reliable workers that finish 50-step tasks without spiraling. We are solving the math of multi-step reliability through engineering, not wishful thinking.</p> <p><strong>What You Will Solve</strong></p> <p>You will work on the <strong>Agentic Harness</strong>, treating the LLM as a component within a larger, deterministic control system. Your research will focus on:</p> <ul> <li>Architecting loops that survive error accumulation. You will build verification layers that force the agent to recognize its own hallucinations and self-correct.</li> <li>You will implement systems where the agent compiles its own constraints and the harness enforces them via constrained decoding or external execution.</li> <li>You will optimise KV-cache hit rates and design "restorable compression" strategies to prevent attention decay.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who We Are Looking For</strong></p> <p>We are looking for <strong>systems thinkers</strong> who happen to know ML, not the other way around.</p> <ul> <li>You know that a demo is not a product. You prefer deterministic guardrails over "prompting it to be nicer."</li> <li>You are willing to read a 500-line trace of a failed agent loop to find the exact moment the context drifted. items.snippet: About Nomos Europe pays more than twice as much for electricity as the US or Asia. To reach competitive price levels, Europe has to lean on solar and deliver the flexibility that makes this feasible. Nomos is building a full-stack power company to unlock that flexibility by connecting millions of homes to Europe’s energy markets. At Nomos, we care about our craft and take full responsibility for what we build. We hire for spikes, not an absence of weaknesses, and look for exceptional ability backed by a record of achievement. This has brought together IMO and IOI medalists, former founders and Olympic athletes in a team whose individual strengths reinforce one another. What you’ll do We build software that connects the energy market to thousands of physical assets, and we own almost all of it ourselves. You’ll be directly responsible for building the product, on real projects rather than intern projects. Own real engineering projects end to end, from working out the problem to shipping it. Work on our own stack, with AI as part of how you build every day. Work directly with commercial teams, because the hard problems here are not purely technical. Exciting challenges Own an entire challenge. Recent interns built forecasting functions around seasonality and temperature and owned the build-out of a data analytics pipeline and a liquidity risk monitoring system. Work where the market meets the physical world. Market events have to reach thousands of devices correctly, and the rules change while the assets are already running. Nobody hands you a defined task. Who you are You’ve excelled at something. You can point to an achievement that took unusual discipline and sustained effort. We want to understand what you accomplished and the work it took to get there. You’ve demonstrated ownership. You’ve taken responsibility for a project, product, or initiative and seen it through. You can explain your decisions and show the result. You go where the complexity is. You want to understand the hard part of a system well enough to solve it. References Vera Lavrova Why join us? As an early member of Nomos, you’ll help shape the company and share in its financial upside. Backed by Index Ventures, we’re building a European category leader in one of the world’s largest industries, making electricity affordable and Europe more competitive. Building a power company from scratch brings complex, rewarding challenges and the chance to solve Europe’s energy crisis for the long term. You’ll learn from people with exceptional depth in their fields, challenge each other’s thinking and take responsibility from the start. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

items.title: Founder's Associate – Praktikum / Intern (m/w/d)
items.snippet: Deine Rolle Die Steuerberatung steht vor ihrer größten Umwälzung seit Jahrzehnten: Nachfolgewelle, Konsolidierung, technologischer Bruch. Die meisten Studierenden lesen darüber in Fallstudien. Hier sitzt du an dem Tisch, an dem entschieden wird. Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen. Darauf bauen wir eine Beratungsplattform für den deutschen Mittelstand, organisch und durch Zukäufe, mit einem gemeinsamen Setup, in das jede neue Einheit integriert wird. Vogel ist inhabergeführt, und du arbeitest unmittelbar an den Themen der Geschäftsführung mit. Du studierst im fortgeschrittenen Bachelor oder im Master oder bist im Gap Year. Die Fachrichtung ist zweitrangig, wichtig ist, dass du herausgestochen bist. Du willst kein Traineeprogramm mit festen Stationen, sondern wissen, wie Entscheidungen tatsächlich entstehen: mit unvollständigen Daten, unter Zeitdruck, zwischen Menschen unterschiedlicher Meinung. Das Praktikum dauert drei bis sechs Monate in Vollzeit. Du verantwortest ein bis zwei eigene Themen und arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung. Deine Verantwortung Analyse und Entscheidungsvorlagen Du nimmst eine offene Frage der Geschäftsführung, strukturierst sie und lieferst eine Antwort auf zwei Seiten, mit eigener Einschätzung. Dein Maßstab: Wer die Vorlage liest, kann danach entscheiden. Du baust Auswertungen aus unseren Zahlen: Ergebnisse je Einheit, Mandatsstrukturen, Auslastung, Wachstumstreiber. Die Daten holst du selbst, deine Annahmen dokumentierst du mit. Du prüfst Annahmen nach, die im Haus als gesetzt gelten, und stellst sachlich fest, wenn etwas nicht mehr stimmt. Eigene Themen von der Frage bis zum Ergebnis Du übernimmst eigene Themen über die gesamte Strecke und trägst die Ergebnisse selbst vor der Geschäftsführung vor. Du arbeitest in laufenden Vorhaben quer durch das Unternehmen mit: Integration eines zugekauften Hauses, Aufbau eines neuen Beratungsfelds, Einführung eines Werkzeugs in allen Einheiten. Interne Steuerung und Kultur Du baust an den Formaten mit, über die das Unternehmen gesteuert wird: Berichtswege, Kennzahlen, Entscheidungsvorlagen, interne Kommunikation. Du verantwortest Anlässe, an denen unsere Kultur konkret wird, von der Town Hall bis zum Sommerfest, gemeinsam mit dem Growth-Team. Du wirkst im Recruiting mit: Sichtung, eigene Einschätzung zu Kandidaten, Mitarbeit am Bewerbungsprozess. Deine Perspektiven Was du nach 3 Monaten geliefert hast: Du hast zwei eigene Themen von der Fragestellung bis zum Ergebnis verantwortet und selbst vorgetragen. Mehrere deiner Entscheidungsvorlagen haben zu tatsächlichen Entscheidungen geführt. Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem. 4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung? Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. items.title: Founding Engineer (m/w/d)
items.snippet: The opportunity Tax advisory runs on structured data, recurring work and clear rules, and almost none of it has been rebuilt with modern software. What decides who gets there first is real case data and engineers who build next to the people doing the work. Vogel advises several thousand mid-sized companies and acquires established advisory firms, developing them further on one shared base. On top of the systems we buy, we build our own software: a data layer above DATEV, the tools our advisors use every day, and agents that take over recurring work. What counts is daily use, on data that is audited and closed. As one of our first engineers, you build across the whole stack: data pipelines, backend, the interfaces advisors use and the agents on top. You take a problem from the first conversation with an advisor to software that runs every day. We are hiring our CTO in parallel, who will own the architecture and lead the team. You work directly with Moritz Vogel. What you'll do Tools advisors use Sit with tax advisors and accountants on real cases, find where the work gets stuck, and turn it into software they use the next day. Your benchmark: an advisor would miss it if it were switched off. Build interfaces, dashboards and internal tools, from the first prototype to something that runs without you. Ship small and often: a tool in daily use beats a perfect plan. Data and integration Build the pipelines that move data out of DATEV and our other systems into our own data layer every night, checked from the first day. Define every figure exactly once, so a number means the same thing in every tool and report. Connect the systems each acquired firm brings, so one more firm never means one more integration project. Agents and automation Build agents that take over recurring work, with a clear line between what the model judges and what is calculated deterministically. Make every result traceable by version, source and decision, so a certified professional can sign off on it. Evaluate against closed, audited cases, not against test data. Questions you'll answer Which recurring task in an accounting team is the first one worth taking off people's hands, and how do you prove it? How do you build fast now without leaving a mess for the next engineer? When is a prototype ready to run on real data every day, and who signs off before it does? What success looks like 3 months: Your first tool is in daily use by an advisory team, and the nightly data load runs with checks. 6 months: Several tools and the first agents run in regular operation. You own one area end to end, and others build on your code. 12 months: You own a part of our software with its own users, and new engineers learn from your standards. Where it leads: from engineer to owning a product area, as a senior engineer or by leading a team, decided by contribution, not by years served. What you bring A degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, engineering or a related field from a strong university such as TUM, or an equally strong record of your own projects. You have shipped software that other people used, at work, as a working student or in your own project. You write production code in at least one language, ideally Python or TypeScript, and you are at home with SQL and relational databases. AI is your everyday tool: you write, review and test code with it, and you know where it goes wrong. You want breadth across data, backend, interface and agents, and you work in German and in person, because our advisors and clients do. You learn from practitioners, and you set the highest standard in everything you ship, not because someone checks, but because mediocrity bothers you. A plus, not a requirement One to two years as an engineer in a young startup or scale-up, or a working-student role where you owned something real. Knowledge of accounting, tax or DATEV, or data pipelines and agents you have run in production. No conventional CV required: a mathematician or physicist who builds, an information systems graduate with a real engineering track, or the founder of a small product. We assess contribution, not labels. The range shown is not room for negotiation but a profile scale: the lower end stands for starting right after university, the upper third for someone who already carries the standard work of the role on their own. A different background starts at a different market price and converges on the role's level after twelve months of proven performance. What this role is and what it isn't Building on a running business, not a greenfield. DATEV runs and clients do not wait. What you build has to work next to daily operations. An operating company, not a software vendor. The users are our own teams. What we build and in which order is decided together with management; you shape how. Breadth, not a specialist track. If you want to perfect one layer for years, this is the wrong role. Why join us Real data and real users from the first day. Decades of audited, closed work, and advisors who use what you ship the same week. Leverage through acquisitions. Every firm that joins Vogel runs on what you build. Close to the decisions. You work directly with management and see what gets built and why. Hierarchical in decisions, flat in communication, autonomous in execution. Performance is celebrated, not hidden, without politics and without consensus theater. Substance behind you. A profitable, growing business. No funding round decides whether your work continues. items.snippet: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><a href="https://www.crai.com">Charles River Associates</a> is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analyses that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.</p> <p>CRA's <a href="https://www.crai.com/services/antitrust-and-competition/ecp/">European Competition practice</a> specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings:  firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid.  We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation effects of damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.</p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>The Senior Associate position is the entry-level position for applicants with a PhD in Economics and limited work experience. The Senior Associate position is also open to applicants with a Master of Economics and at least 3 years of relevant work experience, within economic consulting or with a competition authority. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/ai-recruiting/">on our website</a>.  </p> <h4>Our Commitment to Diversity</h4> <p>Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.</p> <p><em>The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. items.snippet: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We zijn onderdeel van Burson Group, een internationaal communicatiebureau bestaande uit een groot netwerk met meer dan 95 kantoren in ruim 40 landen. Samen maken wij onderdeel uit van WPP: het grootste marketing- en communicatiebedrijf ter wereld. Sinds 2019 zijn wij onder één dak gevestigd op onze Amsteldok-campus in Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben wij in Nederland ook een kantoor in Den Haag.</p> <p>Public Affairs bij Burson is veel meer dan lobbyen op het Binnenhof. In de huidige mediacratie wordt beleid steeds vaker beïnvloed door publieke opinie en politieke sentimenten. Hierdoor verschuift de macht: niet alleen overheid en markt bepalen de agenda, maar ook de samenleving zelf.  Onze adviseurs helpen organisaties om in te spelen op deze dynamiek: maatschappelijke trends signaleren, draagvlak creëren bij uiteenlopende stakeholders, en strategieën ontwikkelen die zowel politiek als publiek overtuigen.</p> <p>Als geïntegreerd communicatieadviesbureau weten wij hoe we Public Affairs versterken met slimme PR en gerichte communicatie, zodat we de juiste doelgroep bereiken, op het juiste moment, via het juiste kanaal, met de juiste boodschap. Daardoor richten ons op het beïnvloeden van relevante stakeholders via een breed scala aan kanalen.</p> <p>Burson stelt jaarlijks per 1 februari en 1 september een Public Affairs stage beschikbaar aan een talentvolle student.</p> <p><strong>Wat ga je doen?</strong></p> <p>Als stagiair Public Affairs werk je mee aan diverse projecten en ondersteun je onze adviseurs. Je maakt kennis met veel aspecten van het werk binnen een Public Affairs kantoor en krijgt een uniek kijkje achter de schermen van de politieke arena. Je leert hoe organisaties hun belangen behartigen richting politiek, overheid en media. Kortom: een veelzijdige stage op het raakvlak van politiek, bestuur, media en bedrijfsleven.</p> <p><strong>Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Monitoren van nieuws en politiek:</strong>dagelijks kranten, vakbladen en opinietijdschriften scannen op relevant nieuws voor onze klanten.</li> <li><strong>Volgen van parlementaire agenda’s:</strong>bijhouden van vergaderingen en debatten in de Tweede en Eerste Kamer, relevante Kamerstukken signaleren en samenvatten.</li> <li><strong>Verslaglegging</strong>: live en achteraf rapporteren over politieke debatten en griffieverslagen verzamelen.</li> <li><strong>Research en analyse</strong>: informatie verzamelen via databanken en analyses maken voor onze adviseurs.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholdermapping</strong>: relevante politieke en ambtelijke contacten in kaart brengen en up-to-date houden.</li> <li><strong>Ondersteuning bij diverse klantprojecten</strong>: bijdragen aan presentaties, pitches en strategische adviezen.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wie ben jij?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Je volgt een HBO- of universitaire opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Politicologie, Bestuurskunde, Geschiedenis, Europese Studies of Internationale Betrekkingen (en staat ingeschreven tijdens de stageperiode).</li> <li>Je hebt een grote interesse in en kennis van de Nederlandse politiek en maatschappelijke vraagstukken.</li> <li>Je bent proactief, nieuwsgierig en analytisch sterk.</li> <li>Je kunt complexe informatie helder analyseren en samenvatten en hebt een vlotte pen.</li> <li>Je beheerst de Nederlands en Engels taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.</li> <li>Je kunt goed omgaan met deadlines en werkt nauwkeurig, ook onder druk.</li> <li>Je bent minimaal vier dagen per week beschikbaar in de periode van 1 februari tot en met 30 juni.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wat bieden wij</strong></p> <p>Tijdens je stage ontvang je een maandelijkse We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. items.snippet: English version Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s'engager au sein d'une institution où la science et l'innovation construisent un avenir plus durable . C'est une école d'excellence où chacun a la possibilité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d'ingénieurs de France et reconnue à l'international, notre école, membre de l' Institut Mines-Télécom , forme les talents de demain tout en s'engageant activement face aux grands enjeux industriels, numériques et environnementaux. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 membres du personnel et 2 500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : allier excellence académique, recherche de pointe et impact sociétal positif. L'Institut Mines-Télécom rassemble les plus grandes Écoles françaises pour relever les grands défis industriels, numériques, énergétiques et environnementaux. Avec ses huit Grandes Écoles publiques et ses deux Graduate Schools affiliées, il constitue le premier institut public dédié à la formation des ingénieurs et des managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable en formant les leaders qui façonneront les transitions de demain. Le département d'électronique flexible développe des connaissances technologiques et scientifiques dans le domaine de l'électronique souple. Le département dispose d'une solide expertise dans la caractérisation électrique et mécanique des matériaux et des interfaces. Ses activités sont regroupées au sein d'une plateforme de 660 m². Cette plateforme technologique rassemble des installations et des équipements technologiques dédiés aux activités de R&D en micropackaging, micro- et nano-électronique, au sein d'une salle blanche de 220 m² en classe 1000 et de 400 m² en classe 10 000. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant que stagiaire, le/la candidat(e) réalisera des innovations et des activités de recherche dans le domaine de l’électronique. Au sein du département d’électronique flexible (FEL) du Centre de Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), le/la candidat(e) combinera passion des science et désir d’impact sociétal. Ce stage fait partie du projet de recherche Sens-CO qui met en partenariat l’Université Gustave Eiffel, l’Ecole polytechnique et l’Ecole des mines de Saint-Etienne. Ce projet vise à développer un capteur de gaz NOx et COx portable pour un monitoring environnemental en continu. La résistance interne du capteur varie avec la concentration de gaz mesurée. Le rôle du CMP est d’obtenir précisément la valeur de cette résistance à travers un circuit électronique et de permettre la corrélation avec la concentration en gaz ainsi que le traitement et l’envoi des données par communication sans contact. Ce circuit doit permettre une mesure portable et nécessite donc d’être réalisé sur un substrat flexible. Le/la candidat(e) devra ainsi, à partir d’un design réalisé sur PCB rigide, transposer cette interface de capteur de gaz sur un substrat souple en tenant compte des enjeux liés à ces méthodes. Compte tenu de la grande valeur des résistances à mesurer, le PCB final devra permettre : · Une mesure précise de grandes valeurs de résistance · Un faible-bruit et résistance aux interférences électromagnétiques, en tenant compte de l’agencement des composants pour permettre de garantir une flexibilité maximale. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons : Vous êtes actuellement en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur en spécialisation génie électrique, électronique, systèmes embarqués ou domaines associés. Vous devez : · Présenter un fort intérêt pour l’électronique, les systèmes embarqués et la fabrication (soudure, routage et réalisation de circuits électronique). · Présenter une expérience avec les outils de conception de circuits électriques ainsi qu’en conception de PCB et qu’en compatibilité électromagnétique. Une approche expérimentale et une connaissance de conception de circuits imprimés sont essentielles. 🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre les Mines de Saint-Etienne ? Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l'excellence, avec la conviction qu'ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde. Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c'est l'opportunité de trouver : Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un cadre de travail accueillant et un solide réseau international (T.I.M.E., EULiST). Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle représentant 11 millions d'euros par an, principalement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique, La Rotonde, engagé depuis 25 ans dans la médiation scientifique et accueillant plus de 50 000 visiteurs par an. Frais de transports en commun pris en charge à hauteur de 75% (sous conditions), Foyer du personnel (activités sportives, culturelles, avantages CE sur des loisirs et temps de convivialité), 1 jour de congé par mois (à poser sous réserve de l'accord du tuteur) 📩 Postulez Maintenant ! · Date limite de candidature : 02/12/2026 · Durée du stage : 5 à 6 mois · Début du stage : 01/02/2027 · Lieu du stage : Gardanne (13) - France · Gratifications : au taux horaire : 4,50 € par heure de présence effective Les dossiers de candidature sont à déposer sur la plateforme RECRUITEE avant le 02/12/2026 https://institutminestelecom.recruitee.com/o/offre-de-stage-design-et-fabrication-dun-circuit-electronique-flexible-pour-capteur-de-gaz-portable-5-a-6-mois Le poste est ouvert à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap. items.title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
items.snippet: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it. While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from € 20k to € 200k , selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place. Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis). You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting : The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work : One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You are a life-long learner : Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. You build genuine relationships with your customers : The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. In this role you will: Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline. Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer. Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom. Minimum requirements for this role: The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch. Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We'll want to see this on your resume. Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV. Native French language An ideal candidate also offers: Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain. A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results. A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy. Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .
